images.filename: Ceiliog Ffesant. Cock Pheasant - geograph.org.uk - 1256326.jpg
images.caption: Ceiliog Ffesant. Cock Pheasant A familiar sight in Anglesey,  male pheasant have harems of a dozen or more females. The male spends most of his time showing off his finery. On being disturbed he tends to run rather than fly. He is noisy when disturbed. The downturn in the economy has been to the pheasant's advantage with fewer Hooray Henries willing to pay for a days shoot.
